svg.data-fans: 4x hot-swappable 3+1 redundant, exhaust airflow; system front-to-back
svg.data-cpu: Intel Icelake-D 8-core @ 2.1 GHz (Standard) or Icelake-D 16-core @ 2.0 GHz (Premium), with VROC support
svg.data-timing: Stratum 3E OCXO, ITU-T SyncE, IEEE 1588v2 (G.8265.1 default, G.8275.1, G.8275.2, SMPTE ST 2059-2 with additional licence; T-GM, T-BC/OC, T-TC), Time Sensitive Networking, Class C accuracy
svg.data-timing-interfaces: GNSS SMA in, 1PPS SMB in/out, 10MHz SMB in/out, ToD RJ45 in/out
svg.data-gnss: internal receiver for master clock implementations
svg.data-timing-cables: 50 ohm SMA coax with 1/4-36UNS-2B for GNSS; 50 ohm SMB coax with 10-32UNF-2A for 1PPS and 10MHz; shielded RJ45 for ToD
svg.data-nos: NOS integration is necessary to activate the timing features
svg.data-optics-sfp28: 25G SFP28 SR, LR, ER; 10G SFP+ SR, LR, ER; 1G SFP SX, LX, EX (datasheet Compatible Transceivers Types)
svg.data-optics-qsfp28: 100G QSFP28 SR4, LR4, ER4, ZR4 (datasheet Compatible Transceivers Types)
svg.data-optics-sfp-plus: 10G SFP+ SR, LR, ER (datasheet Compatible Transceivers Types; the two 10G management ports take the same optics as the SFP28 cages do at 10G)
svg.data-reset: recessed front-panel pinhole, warm-resets the host CPU when held for less than 10 seconds; HIG section 4.5 warns against sharp tools and asks for the UfiSpace fixture or a flat paperclip
svg.data-emc: FCC Part 15 Subpart B Class A; ICES-003 Class A; EN 55032 Class A; EN 55035; EN 300 386; EN 301 489; EN 303 413; BSMI

circle.data-description: HIG Fan FRU LED table - Off (no input power), Green (fan FRU function normal), Amber (fan FRU abnormal, service is required). Three rows, no blink states: this table is shorter than the S9510-28DC family's and is transcribed as it stands rather than filled out from a sibling

circle.data-description: HIG PSU FRU LED table - Off (no input power to all power supplies), Green (output on and OK), Blinking Green (standby state / only +5VSB on, or firmware updating), Red (critical event causing shutdown - failure, over current, short circuit, over voltage, fan failure, over temperature), Blinking Red (input power lost with a second supply in parallel still powered), Blinking between Green and Red (warning event, supply continues to operate - high temp, high power, high current, slow fan)

g.data-description: HIG section 8 - the designated grounding location, at the rear of the case and shipped covered with a protective label; two M4 screws and two washers, upper hole
g.title: ground-1

g.data-description: the lower of the two tapped holes of the same rear grounding location
